forms.thankYouDetail: Your application has been received successfully. Our team will review your information and you will receive a confirmation email shortly. If you do not receive an email within 24 hours, please check your spam folder.
forms.checkEmail: Please check your email (including spam/junk folder) for updates on your application.
forms.couldNotConfirm: We couldn't confirm your submission. Please check your email — if we received it, you'll hear from us shortly.
forms.consentLabel: I agree that my details are recorded to manage my registration, my payment and my access to this course.
forms.consentRequired: Please accept the recording of your details to continue.
forms.paymentMisconfigured: This course is not open for online payment. Please contact us.
forms.paymentVerifyingHint: This can take up to two minutes. Keep this page open.
forms.paymentSuccessBody: Your access is ready. Choose your password to enter your course.
forms.paymentEmailNote: We also sent you an email — it is your receipt and your way back in if you close this page.
forms.paymentFailed: The payment did not go through
forms.paymentFailedBody: Your registration is saved — you can try again without re-entering your details.
forms.paymentPending: Your payment is still being confirmed
forms.paymentPendingBody: We have not received the confirmation yet. Do not pay again — your payment will be confirmed automatically.
forms.paymentUnavailable: Online payment is not available yet
forms.paymentUnavailableBody: The payment window is not configured on this server. Please contact us to complete your registration.
forms.existingBody: A registration already exists for this email on this course. Sign in, or receive a fresh link by email.
forms.existingResendSent: If a registration exists for this address, a link is on its way.
forms.resumeInvalid: This link is no longer valid
forms.resumeInvalidBody: It may have expired or been replaced. Ask for a fresh one from your confirmation email.
